title: News feeds follow the searched market, not Milwaukee by default
body: The Business Journals panel used to fall back to Milwaukee whenever the county was outside the 10 featured metros (e.g. searching jobs in La Crosse). `/api/news` now resolves any of Wisconsin’s 72 counties, La Crosse has its own biz feed, and Milwaukee-only headlines are filtered out of other markets.

title: Graceful rate-limit copy with a retry window
body: 429 / quota errors no longer read as hard failures. The map dock and jobs banners explain that sources are cooling down, include a human retry window (about 5 minutes, or Retry-After when present), and keep live map data available.

title: Statewide transit map: routes, stops, and live vehicles
body: Seven Wisconsin agencies (MCTS, Madison Metro, Green Bay, La Crosse MTU, Kenosha, Valley Transit, Eau Claire) expose GTFS route shapes, stops, and GTFS-RT vehicles where feeds exist. `/transit` has an agency picker, layer toggles, and a mobile bottom sheet for stop/route/bus details.

title: County explorer: one stats panel, readable peer chart
body: Tapping a county no longer stacks a vague “news vibe” card on top of labor stats. The panel shows unemployment with statewide rank, income, and jobs. Lowest-unemployment peers use a padded dot-plot axis so 2.5% vs 2.8% is visually distinct.

title: Compact prompt carousel with a 26-character label cap
body: Starter prompts sit in a single-row auto-advancing carousel (swipe, chevrons, pause on hover). Every visible label is clamped to 26 characters so headlines never clip. News chips read `News · {place}`; the full prompt is still sent on tap.

title: Unit tests for map, jobs, news, and transit logic
body: Vitest covers county lookup, query→area sync, biz-journal relevance, unemployment rank copy, jobs error states, rate-limit messaging, transit agencies, and carousel label limits. Run with `npm test`.
